subject: I could not combine these two types of plots - ribbon and bar ? How can it be done ?

messages.author: 6f7b392112a8650a
messages.subject: I could not combine these two types of plots - ribbon and bar ? How can it be done ?
parts:
months <- c(1:12)
High <- c(-6,-2,5,14,21,26,28,27,22,14,4,-3)
Low <- c(-16,-11,-5,2,9,14,17,16,11,4,-4,-12)
Mean <- c(-11,-7,0,8,15,20,23,22,16,9,1,-7)
Prep <- c(26.4 ,20.1 ,47.2 ,58.7 ,82.3 ,110.2 ,102.6 ,102.9 ,68.3 ,
53.6 ,49.3 ,25.4 )
minptemp <- data.frame(months, High, Low, Mean, Prep)
require(ggplot2)
plt <- ggplot(minptemp, aes(x= months))
plt + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin= Low, ymax= High), fill="yellow") +
geom_line(aes(y=Mean, col = "red")) + geom_bar(aes(y=Prep, x =
as.factor(months)), colour="darkgreen") + theme_bw( )
